def autocorrelation_and_effective_sample_size(
    values: Array,
    *,
    max_lag: int = 100,
) -> tuple[Array, Array, Array]:
    """Estimate a positive-sequence autocorrelation time and sample count."""

    centered = values - jnp.mean(values)
    denominator = jnp.dot(centered, centered)
    lag_limit = min(max_lag, values.shape[0] - 1)
    full_correlation = jnp.correlate(centered, centered, mode="full")
    numerators = full_correlation[
        values.shape[0] - 1 : values.shape[0] + lag_limit
    ]
    correlation = numerators / jnp.where(denominator > 0.0, denominator, 1.0)
    constant_series = jnp.concatenate(
        (jnp.ones(1, dtype=values.dtype), jnp.zeros(lag_limit, dtype=values.dtype))
    )
    correlation = jnp.where(denominator > 0.0, correlation, constant_series)

    positive_prefix = jnp.cumprod((correlation[1:] > 0.0).astype(values.dtype))
    integrated_time = jnp.maximum(
        1.0,
        1.0 + 2.0 * jnp.sum(correlation[1:] * positive_prefix),
    )
    effective_samples = values.shape[0] / integrated_time
    return correlation, integrated_time, effective_samples


phi = 0.9
noise = jax.random.normal(jax.random.PRNGKey(606), (6_000,))
_, correlated = jax.lax.scan(
    lambda previous, xi: (
        phi * previous + jnp.sqrt(1.0 - phi**2) * xi,
        phi * previous + jnp.sqrt(1.0 - phi**2) * xi,
    ),
    0.0,
    noise,
)
correlated = correlated[1_000:]
correlation, tau_int, n_eff = autocorrelation_and_effective_sample_size(
    correlated, max_lag=200
)
naive_se = jnp.std(correlated, ddof=1) / jnp.sqrt(correlated.size)
corrected_se = jnp.std(correlated, ddof=1) / jnp.sqrt(n_eff)
print(f"analytic tau_int={(1 + phi) / (1 - phi):.1f}")
print(f"estimated tau_int={float(tau_int):.2f}")
print(f"raw samples={correlated.size}, effective samples={float(n_eff):.1f}")
print(f"naive SE={float(naive_se):.4f}, correlation-aware SE={float(corrected_se):.4f}")
Output
